    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # Full-width 4s partition the grid into horizontal compartments.
    bars = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 4 for v in g[r])]
    bounds = [-1] + bars + [h]
    blocks = [(bounds[i] + 1, bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(bounds)-1)]
    # Use the first nonempty compartment as a repeating template for empty ones.
    source = None
    for a, b in blocks:
        if any(v != 4 for row in g[a:b] for v in row):
            source = (a, b)
            break
    if source is not None:
        sa, sb = source
        template = [row[:] for row in g[sa:sb]]
        for a, b in blocks:
            if (a, b) == source or b-a != len(template):
                continue
            if not any(v != 4 for row in g[a:b] for v in row):
                g[a:b] = [row[:] for row in template]
    # Where vertical 4-lines delineate a narrow panel, the template is the
    # occupied panel below the horizontal bar; reproduce it in the blank panel above.
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c] == 4 for r in range(h))]
    if len(cols) >= 2:
        left, right = cols[0], cols[-1]
        bars = [r for r in range(h) if all(g[r][c] == 4 for c in range(w))]
        if bars:
            bar = bars[0]
            top, bottom = list(range(0, bar)), list(range(bar+1, h))
            if len(top) == len(bottom):
                for i, r in enumerate(top):
                    for c in range(left+1, right):
                        g[r][c] = g[bottom[i]][c]
    return g

if __name__ == '__main__':

    expected = demo[:5] + [row[:] for row in demo[:5]] + [row[:] for row in demo[:4]]
    assert transform(demo) == expected
    test = [[9]*26 for _ in range(5)]
    for r in range(5): test[r][8] = test[r][17] = 4
    test[2] = [4]*26
    test[3][9:17] = [8,9,8,9,6,9,8,7]
